title: Remote Internal Alpha Productization
objective: Make remote testing nearly frictionless for non-developer testers through installer/onboarding, role setup, guided scenarios, automatic evidence capture, diagnostics, bug bundles, instructions, version verification and update flow.
acceptance: Invited testers on supported environments can install, join, execute assigned scenarios and return actionable evidence without developer hand-holding.
boundaries: SMB-01..12, SMB10A/B and SAA-01..30 remain sealed predecessor contracts.
SMB-13 owns remote internal-alpha productization only; it does not grant public beta/release, commerce, marketplace/community publication or unrelated domain mutation.
Remote tester flows must preserve canonical Campaign/World/Character/Scene and session authority; evidence capture is diagnostic and cannot mutate canonical gameplay state.
Installer/onboarding/update flows must fail closed on unsupported or incompatible versions and preserve recoverability.
SMB-14 security/privacy/family-safety hardening and later work remain unauthorized until verified SMB-13 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for non-developer remote-alpha installation/onboarding, role setup, guided scenarios, automatic evidence capture, diagnostics/bug bundles, instructions, version verification and update flow; then implement only SMB-13.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SMB-13 after verified SMB-12 closeout.
